title: Affine models of base change by a quotient
statement: Let $A,D$ be commutative rings, $I\subset A$ an ideal, $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a morphism, and $j:\operatorname{Spec}D\to X$ any morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $Z=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projection $i:Z\to X$, and let $\alpha:A\to D$ correspond to $j\circ p$. There is an isomorphism $e:Z\times_X\operatorname{Spec}D\simeq\operatorname{Spec}(D/\alpha(I)D)$ whose composite with the quotient-spectrum map to $\operatorname{Spec}D$ is the second projection. No openness, finiteness or reducedness assumption is required.

proof.text: Paste the two defining pullback squares. The result is the pullback of j followed by p and Spec(A/I) over Spec A.

The affine pullback is Spec(D tensor_A A/I). The ring equivalence D/ID to this tensor product sends the class of d to d tensor 1, with inverse d tensor a-bar mapped to the class of d alpha(a). The adopted source library packages precisely this as CommRingCat.isPushout_quotient. Applying Spec gives the quotient pullback square. Compare the two pullback cones; their first projections give the asserted equation.

theorem quotient_base_change_affine_model {X : Scheme.{u}} (A : CommRingCat.{u})
    (p : X ⟶ Spec A) (I : Ideal A) (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (j : Spec D ⟶ X) :
    ∃ e : pullback (pullback.fst p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) j ≅
        Spec (.of (D ⧸ Ideal.map (Spec.preimage (j ≫ p)).hom I)),
      e.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk _)) = pullback.snd _ j
